thought.text: S3 buckets created (attachments, validation with 30-day lifecycle, mapproxycache). Now Liquibase for the XPlanDB schema. Let me get it:

reasoning_content:
The S3 buckets have been created. Next, let's install Liquibase (needed for DB schema initialization). I'll also keep an eye on the build.

Let's install Liquibase. The guide says to download it. I'll grab the Liquibase Community edition.

action.command:
cd /opt
# Liquibase Community. Try GitHub release.
timeout 30 curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/liquibase/liquibase/releases?per_page=3 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(r['tag_name']) for r in d[:3]]" 2>&1 | head
